test_mtm_model_smoke: test the MTM model by running a smoke test with random trajectory data and masks
create_mtm_model: create an MTM model instance with data shapes, trajectory length, and MTMConfig parameters
create_mtm_config: create an MTMConfig with n_embd, n_head, n_enc_layer, n_dec_layer, and dropout settings
run_mtm_forward: run the MTM model forward pass with trajectory tensors and attention masks
review_mtm_model_shapes: review the MTM model to verify output trajectory shapes match input trajectory shapes
